purpose.filtering: Derive introduction year from introductionDate for year/year-or-later filters
purpose.analytics: Support year-based aggregate and longitudinal analysis

resolutionRules: Treat introduction date as an approximate nationwide hall-introduction reference date; regional differences of a few days are acceptable.
When trustworthy sites disagree, prefer the date supported by the majority of independent sources.
Do not create UNRESOLVED debt solely because trustworthy sources differ by a small regional rollout offset when a clear majority date exists.

If sources are evenly split, prefer manufacturer/industry source when it explicitly states a nationwide introduction/start date; otherwise keep the most widely reported date and record the conflict in the audit evidence.
Do not use catalog.addedAt as introductionDate.
Store the full date; derive introductionYear rather than storing it separately.
preferredCrossCheckSources: other established pachislot machine databases/major analysis sites
manufacturer or official machine pages when an explicit introduction date is available
